question: I get the impression that other than Capella, the sin archbishops are incomprehensible scum, but Capella is comprehensible scum; why is that? Is her scumness still a work in progress?
answer: Don’t you feel that someone you can understand a little bit makes you feel worse than someone you can’t understand at all? A little part of me is the same as Capella; in other words, you are Capella. You turned everyone into flies. In the same situation, you’re the kind of person who would turn other people into flies. Doesn’t it make you feel that way? It’s that kind of thing.
